opportunities.title: [Bounty: $50] Reject non-decimal amounts and malformed currency codes in quoteSchema
opportunities.summary: ## Context payments.schema.ts quoteSchema validates amount with z.string().min(1).transform(normalizeAmount) and currency with z.string().min(3).max(3). No numeric pattern is enforced, so values such as "abc", "-5", "1.2.3", "" after trim, or "1e999" all pass validation, and currency accepts lowercase or digit strings like "usd" and "123" even though the default is the uppercase code "USD".
